headline: Saima Wazed Putul resigns as WHO regional head amid fraud allegations
summary: The daughter of ousted PM Sheikh Hasina stepped down following investigations into financial fraud and misrepresented academic credentials.
details: Saima Wazed Putul, the World Health Organization's Southeast Asia head, has resigned from her position. The move follows fraud investigations conducted by both the UN agency and Bangladeshi authorities.
Putul was placed on unpaid administrative leave late last year after Bangladesh's Anti-Corruption Commission filed charges alleging fraud and forgery in March 2025.
The WHO specifically accused Putul of committing financial fraud regarding her travel to China and misrepresenting her academic credentials.
Additionally, the WHO alleged she illegally acquired a plot of land in Bangladesh, which Putul claims was acquired legally under laws covering the families of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.
In her resignation letter, Putul expressed a loss of trust in WHO leadership and cited an untenable financial situation after nearly a year without pay.
Putul has denied the allegations, claiming the travel fraud was an administrative oversight involving $901 and that her honorary doctorate was clearly disclosed.
Regional directors are among the most influential health policy officials globally, managing outbreak responses and adapting WHO policies for member states like India and Bangladesh.
caption:
Saima Wazed Putul has resigned as the WHO's Southeast Asia head following allegations of financial fraud and forgery.

Saima Wazed Putul, the World Health Organization's Southeast Asia head, has resigned from her position. The move follows fraud investigations conducted by both the UN agency and Bangladeshi authorities.

Putul was placed on unpaid administrative leave late last year after Bangladesh's Anti-Corruption Commission filed charges alleging fraud and forgery in March 2025.

The WHO specifically accused Putul of committing financial fraud regarding her travel to China and misrepresenting her academic credentials.

Additionally, the WHO alleged she illegally acquired a plot of land in Bangladesh, which Putul claims was acquired legally under laws covering the families of Sheikh Mujibur Rahman.

In her resignation letter, Putul expressed a loss of trust in WHO leadership and cited an untenable financial situation after nearly a year without pay.

Putul has denied the allegations, claiming the travel fraud was an administrative oversight involving $901 and that her honorary doctorate was clearly disclosed.

Regional directors are among the most influential health policy officials globally, managing outbreak responses and adapting WHO policies for member states like India and Bangladesh.

headline: Apple unveils iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone
summary: The device features a book-style design with a 7.6-inch inner display and a 5.4-inch outer screen, starting at $1,999.
details: Apple has introduced the iPhone Duo, its first foldable smartphone. The device features a book-style design with a 7.6-inch inner display and a 5.4-inch inner display, and is the thinnest iPhone ever made when opened.

The outer Super Retina XDR display is roughly 90% of the size of the iPhone 18 Pro, while the inner screen is 50% larger than the iPhone 18 Pro Max. Both screens support ProMotion, Always-On display, and a peak brightness of 3,000 nits.
The phone is built from grade 5 titanium with a hinge consisting of over 100 components. It is IP68 rated for water and dust resistance and uses Ceramic Shield 2 for front display protection.
Powered by the A20 Pro chip, the iPhone Duo offers up to 35% better sustained performance than the iPhone 17 Pro. It includes a custom vapour-chamber cooling system to maintain high performance.
iOS 27 introduces new multitasking features for the foldable design, including Split View for running two apps side-by-side and the ability to interact with Siri AI while keeping other apps visible.
The camera system features a 48-megapixel Fusion Main camera and a 48-megapixel ultra-wide camera. It can record 4K video at 120fps in Dolby Vision and includes a 'Duo Preview' for live framing.
The device uses a dual-battery design to provide up to 31 hours of video playback on the inner display and 44 hours on the outer screen. Wired charging can reach 50% in about 20 minutes.
Available in star white and night sky, the iPhone Duo comes in storage capacities from 256GB to 2TB. Pre-orders begin October 16, with availability in over 70 countries starting October 23.
caption:

The camera system features a 48-megapixel Fusion Main camera and a 48-megapixel ultra-wide camera. It can record 4K video at 120fps in Dolby Vision and includes a 'Duo Preview' for live framing.
